NW Sector Community Meeting: CPA(SS)2025-07 & MAJMOD 2025-08 Bartram Grove
The requested applications propose to: (1) modify the Bartram Park DRI 2001-139 (as amended, 2019-166) to add 42.3 acres+/- located on the south side of Race Track Road, between East Peyton Parkway and State Road 9B, to the DRI boundary; increase the maximum commercial entitlement to 500,000 square feet; and convert 20,000 square feet of commercial entitlements to 169 residential dwelling units (DUs), increasing the maximum number of residential dwelling units from 646 to 815 with no additional external vehicular trips added; (2) modify PUD Ordinance 2017-15 (MAJMOD 2025-08) to rename the development to "Bartram Grove PUD and allow a maximum of 90 single-family DUs, 90 multifamily DUs, and 50,000 square feet of commercial and office uses; and (3) revise the 2050 Future Land Use Map designation (CPA(SS) 2025-07) of approximately 44.29 acres +/- from Intensive Commercial (IC) to Mixed Use District (MD) and to amend site specific text Policy A.1.11.1(m)(8)(x) to limit the development to a maximum of 180 residential DUs (90 single family attached & 90 single family detached), along with 50,000 square feet of retail/commercial and office uses on the subject property. Proposed access to the subject property will be provided via Race Track Road.
